literal: Prospering fate-by appears sluggishness-absence; hand-wealth going fate-by appears laziness.
translation: Through the fate that brings prosperity, tireless effort arises. Through the fate that takes away accumulated wealth, laziness arises.
modern: செல்வம் பெருகுவதற்கான ஊழ் இருக்கும்போது தளராத முயற்சி உண்டாகும். கையில் உள்ள செல்வம் அழிவதற்கான ஊழ் இருக்கும்போது சோம்பல் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how destiny operates by influencing a person's mindset and actions. The phrase 'ஆகு ஊழ்' refers to a fate of prospering, which naturally brings about 'அசைவின்மை' (the absence of sluggishness, or tireless effort). Conversely, when the fate of losing ('போகு ஊழ்') one's accumulated wealth ('கைப்பொருள்') is active, 'மடி' (laziness) takes over. Thus, destiny shapes outcomes by instilling either industriousness or sloth.
